biography:
I believe leadership is earned through clarity, transparency, accountability, empowerment and shared ambition — not titles. That mindset was shaped early through competitive sport and responsibility, and I’ve applied it consistently across sales, operations, strategy and full P&L leadership.

Over the past decade, my focus has been in the data center and digital infrastructure industry, where I’ve had the privilege to help shape growth at scale. As CEO of Green Mountain Data Centers, I led the company through a hyperscale expansion phase, delivering 300%+ growth, securing Europe’s largest colocation agreement, tripling operational footprint, and restructuring the organization for future scale.

Following that inflection point, we established Green Mountain Global — a holding and investment platform built to support long-term expansion. I now serve as Global Chief Business Officer, responsible for growth strategy, revenue execution, strategic partnerships and M&A globally.

I love solving challenges by shifting perspectives. Whether it’s a new market opportunity or a complex customer requirement, I thrive on turning ambiguity into direction and direction into results.
-I put the customer at the center of decisions
-I challenge the status quo, but ground it in insight and persistence
-I trust my instincts, but validate with data and great people

I build teams that believe in the mission — and in each other. I’ve led teams from 5 to 500+, and my greatest pride is not just in what we delivered, but in who they became along the way, whether they stayed with me or went on to lead elsewhere.
-Commercial clarity — make direction obvious
-Operational discipline — structure follows strategy
-People first — cultures win, not individuals
Being recognized as Sustainability Leader of the Year (Infrastructure Masons) and Technology Leader of the Year Europe (Tech Capital) reflects both results and resilience.

I’m not driven by titles or next steps — I’m driven by building platforms that develop, grow and last.
I take just as much pride in watching people succeed within my team as I do in seeing them go on to lead elsewhere. Legacy isn’t only performance — it’s what you help others become.
Whether coaching teams in sport or leading expansion in business, my focus has always been the same: build belief, set high standards, and move forward together.

Challenge me, and see what I can do to create growth and opportunities for you.
